title: A resource lifecycle
description: States describe what a resource is; transition labels describe events. A paused state preserves identity until the resource resumes.

data.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> Published: approve
    Published --> Paused: suspend
    Paused --> Published: resume
    Published --> Archived: retire
    Paused --> Archived: retire
    Archived --> [*]
